notes.title: Major Update: Artifacts & enemies' subfactions – 26.05.25
notes.notes:
WARNIG! Old saves are not compatible with this update.

[b]Major Changes[/b]
[b]I. [/b]Added a new item type: artifacts, along with a new interactive spell-casting system.
[b]II.[/b] Enemies are now organized into subfactions based on race (e.g., goblins, orcs, ogres = greenskins; elementals, undead, spiders = monsters), and may now fight units from other groups.
[b]III.[/b] Completely reworked skill icons and scene illustration. 

[b]Minor Changes:[/b]
1. Improved shaders and sprite visuals.
2. Refined UI interactions for smoother and more responsive gameplay.
3. Added support for both fullscreen and windowed display modes.


[b]Current Focus:[/b]
[i]Right now, I'm working on expanding the artifact-spell system. What’s in the game currently is more of a concept stage, but the goal is to introduce around 20 unique spells with different effects and costs.

At the same time, I'm also working on UI improvements and general quality-of-life tweaks. Big thanks to everyone who's been sharing suggestions — a lot of them are making their way onto the to-do list![/i]

notes.title: Changelog – 11.05.25
notes.notes:
[b]WARNIG! Old saves are not compatible with this update.[/b]

1. Rebalanced item categories and removed about 10% of redundant items.
2. Adjusted requirements for building construction and upgrades.
3. Updated weapon selection logic to favor weapons that target enemy weaknesses.
4. Heroes now discard excess cheap items if they hold more than five (excluding consumables).
5. Improved navigation logic for smoother pathfinding.
6. Added new variable mappings for use in text-based events.
7. Refined meta-logic structure for event handling.
8. Added two new events.
9. Made minor changes to scenario maps.
10. Added new illustrations for events.

[i]Work in Progress:
Artifact-type items will be implemented to let players cast spells like fireballs or healing on units.[/i]

notes.title: Future Plans for Fantasy Trader
notes.notes:
10.04.2025

Thank you all for your interest in Fantasy Trader!
I'm truly happy to see such a warm reception of the game, even during its early access phase. It's incredibly rewarding to know that three years of learning to code, designing systems, and creating/editing assets have resulted in something that resonates with fellow gaming enthusiasts.

Encouraged by your support, I'm diving back into development with fresh energy and enthusiasm.
Below is a breakdown of my plans, along with a changelog of today's small improvements.


Development Task List

Tasks for the Bard Guild
- Expand event content
- Develop and add new hero events
- Develop and add new hero-related dilemmas

Tasks for the Scribe Guild
- Edit and refine existing events (priority)
- Edit and refine hero events (priority)
- Edit and refine hero dilemmas (priority)

Tasks for the Artist Guild
- Add new illustrations
- Add new animations

Tasks for the Hayekian Order
- Add more descriptions for market events and their economic interpretations (priority)

Tasks for the Guild of Wizard-Creators
- Find and eliminate bugs (priority)
- Add artifacts-type goods (also usable for player - f.e. for healing heroes, teleportation or casting fireball)
- Create new regions
- Optimize the rules governing the world of the Fantastical Trader
